content: Dog vomiting can happen because of food changes, eating unsuitable items, infections, parasites, or digestive problems. If vomiting continues or contains blood, veterinary attention is recommended.
Dogs commonly require vaccines such as rabies, distemper, parvovirus and other core vaccinations depending on veterinary recommendations.
Cats refusing food may happen because of stress, dental problems, infections or illness. If a cat does not eat for more than 24 hours veterinary advice is recommended.
Pets need balanced nutrition suitable for their species, age and health condition. Avoid feeding harmful human foods.
Difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, seizures, poisoning and unconsciousness require immediate veterinary care.
